reviews.comment:
Fui a cargar combustible y no me quisieron cargar xq dicen que había cambio de precios después de las 00hs, que supuestamente el sistema se cerraba y que en todas las estaciones de servicio era igual. Me hicieron perder tiempo! Para que? Fui a la que está en Guido y Panamericana y me dijeron que eso se hace automáticamente, ellos estaban cargando de forma normal. Sea un minuto ó una hora, NO está bien hacer perder el tiempo a los demás!! No pido que me regalen nada, pido que no jueguen con mi tiempo que si vale!!
Obviamente no me querían cargar para luego cobrar más caro el combustible. Lleno el tanque cada 2 días con infinia. Perdieron un cliente. No vuelvo más!

(Translated by Google)
I went to get gas and they wouldn't fill up because they said there was a price change after midnight, that supposedly the system shuts down, and that it was the same at all gas stations. They wasted my time! For what? I went to the one at Guido and Panamericana and they told me that it happens automatically, they were filling up normally. Whether it's a minute or an hour, it's NOT okay to waste other people's time!! I'm not asking for anything for free, I'm asking them not to play with my time, which is valuable!!
Obviously, they didn't want to fill up so they could charge me more later. I fill up every two days with Infinia. They lost a customer. I'm not coming back!
